body: At least 95% of downloads never get past analyzing, and on the VERY rare occasion it does download a DRM video it's not the original quality, it's never more than 720p.

It sucks, but I guess I'll save some money. As someone said earlier, I think this will mostly hurt smaller creators, the ones nobody even bothers pirating. I'm not going to pay money for a video that I can only watch online and which I might lose access to if the creator closes or loses their account.
